what: The vertical photo cell beside the Hero appears as soon as it opens, with the clip lifting from the right edge to the left (2.8s power2.out) while the photo inside slowly settles from 1.05 → 1x (7s power2.out). On wide screens (1024px and up), scrolling folds the cell width to 0 with the right edge as the axis — from when the section top touches the top of the screen until the center of the reference text (title) reaches the center of the screen, scrub .7. While folding, the photo keeps its initial size stuck to the bottom right so it looks cut off, and the margin always trimmed on the right (40px) also goes to 0. The fold share is exported as --fx-fold so the adjacent text widens along with it

options.dur: Open duration (sec), default 2.8 — 0 shows it right away
options.settle: Photo sink duration (sec), default 7 — 0 for none
options.delay: Open delay in seconds, default 0 — use when opening after the white curtain lifts
options.pad: Margin (px) always trimmed on the right, default 40 — 0 when collapsed
options.wide: Screen condition for applying the fold, default (min-width: 1024px)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Folding photo slot (required) — height is set by the side that uses it
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Photo frame inside cell (first child if none)
options.[data-fx-part=anchor]: Reference text for when collapsing ends — fully collapsed when its center reaches the screen center (the attached element if none)

use: …

from.where: index.html .h-intro — Hero tall photo on the right, the text beside the title widens with --fx-fold

note: While folding, the original pins the header nav for the same range (pinSpacing false) to shrink the right margin by the photo’s width. That is the site’s job (index.js), so it is not in the part.
